purpose: Exercise the rare paths of measurement/step.c that a production-parameter sample does not reach: restarts at distinguished points, abandonment at the trail cap, and false filter matches (8-bit filters) that launch exact cycle checks, including distinguished points first reached during a look-ahead (ahead_dps)
builds: measurement/step.c compiled with the flags below (organizer image and flags), walk_ref.py run with the same values in its environment (ADDER_BITS, B, DP_BITS, CAP_PERIODS, FILTER_BITS)
inputs: walk_ref.py gen with ADDER_BITS=6 B=4096, seed 7
record_check: each distinguished point, including a look-ahead one, is recorded as its own point; kernel and replica agree on dp_digest, a digest of every record's key
